title: Onboarding: plan dashes and hand off
text: /yoke onboard surveys existing work, helps the operator write goals and a high-level CURRENT-PLAN ready for parallel dashes, and configures only what those first dashes need. It files no items and hands off to /yoke steer to vet and present each dash for approval, then assign its done test, flow and QA plan when filing. Project activation remains an item reaching done.
